record.original_question: Let M be a component of the moduli space of canonical models of surfaces of general type with fixed invariants K^2 and χ. Find conditions ensuring that there exists a flat family over a disc whose general fibre is the general surface in M and whose central fibre is an irreducible, reduced rational surface.

evidence.quote: Problem 6 (Ciro Ciliberto) Give conditions under which the following happens. Let M be a component of MK2,χ . Then there is a flat family over a disc such that the general fibre is the general surface in M and the central fibre is an irreducible, reduced rational surface.

artifact.category_tag: Degenerations of surfaces of general type
artifact.status_search_result: The problem is posed as an open problem on conditions for degenerating a general surface of general type in a moduli component to an irreducible reduced rational surface. No published resolution providing such general conditions was located; related work on degenerations (e.g. Ciliberto–Lopez–Miranda for K3 surfaces, and studies of multiple point formulas for degenerations of surfaces) addresses adjacent questions but does not settle this one.

status_evidence.title: Open problems
status_evidence.snippet: Problem posed by Ciliberto asking for conditions under which a component M of the moduli of canonical models admits a flat family over a disc with rational central fibre.
status_evidence.claim: The question is recorded as an open problem.

status_evidence.title: On the K^2 of degenerations of surfaces and the multiple point formula
status_evidence.snippet: Studies constraints on invariants of smooth surfaces degenerating to unions of planes and related configurations.
status_evidence.claim: Related results constrain but do not resolve the general degeneration-to-rational question.
